images.author: Niceckhart
images.caption: This is former Kroger store now occupied by Giant Eagle. Kroger vacated this store in w:Vermilion, Ohio when they pulled out of Northeastern Ohio.

brief: A 1990s single-storey supermarket in a strip centre: a long pale block front with a red-lettered sign, a canopy and a big car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a supermarket-anchored neighbourhood centre (Vermilion OH, 1995): the grocery anchor (with pharmacy) at one end of a strip of smaller stores under a continuous mansard canopy, behind a large parking field with cart corrals

why.note: the neighbourhood centre: a supermarket anchor and in-line shops behind a parking field
